rationale: VERSION 2.1.0 -> 3.0.0 and pinned the canonical rule at 0df093c037e1.; Replaced six coupled, dead, contradictory, or invalid controls with one exact scene_profile axis observable from every returned grid.; Added a five-in-sixteen default prior retaining all four training inputs and the held-out input as linked profiles; dimensions, signal count, cue relationship, and complete lower stripe stay linked while colors and signal-column placement are nuisance.; Added eight exact background/signal/cue relationship profiles covering zero and colored backgrounds, same/distinct cues, cue 6, and signal 6.; Added minimum-height, tall-stripe, and wide-stripe boundary lessons spanning heights 3..22 and widths 5..24.; Added a complete semantic analyzer, strong self_check, override observer, independent Python rule mirror, deterministic fresh returns, and focused regression tests.; Synchronized the base executable Racket sources to the canonical authority.
summary: Read the background from input cell (2,1). Copy input rows 0 and 1 as output rows 0 and 1. Build output row 2 column-by-column: preserve the background where row 0 equals that background, and write magenta 6 everywhere row 0 is non-background.
